heading: Technical work becomes more useful when the team can act on it.

items.title: Subsystem coordination
items.text: As Formula EV’s Low Voltage Electronics Lead, coordinate electrical planning with the mechanical and software constraints around the Formula UA27 vehicle.

items.title: Engineering communication
items.text: Built dashboards, inspection scopes, lifecycle summaries, and technical deliverables that turn source data and engineering judgement into work others can review and use.

items.title: Student leadership
items.text: Engineering Student Engagement Leader and recipient of the Undergraduate Student Leadership Award (2024–2025).
